mechanism: Amphotericin B causes significant nephrotoxicity and electrolyte disturbances (hypokalemia, hypomagnesemia) which may reduce eslicarbazepine levels through altered renal clearance and increase CNS toxicity risk.
action: Monitor renal function, electrolytes, and eslicarbazepine levels closely; ensure aggressive hydration during amphotericin B therapy; consider alternative antifungal if possible.
